title: Extending Expired Cybersecurity Authorities Act
latest_action: Read the second time. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 182.
summary: Extending Expired Cybersecurity Authorities Act This bill extends the Cybersecurity Information Sharing Act of 2015 through FY2035. The act includes authorities and requirements that facilitate the voluntary sharing of cyber threat information between private sector entities and the federal government. The bill also renames the act as the Protecting America from Cyber Threats Act. For more information about the act, see CRS In Focus 12959 .

journey.note: Reported by committee; waiting for a floor vote
